description: 385 source-grounded craft rules in six versioned packs (craft, paragraph, document, operations, structural lenses, narrative foundations), each with principle, rationale, scopes, edit moves, signals, procedure, avoid-when, preserve, conflicts, sources and before/after examples. Projected into prompts mechanically; selected by judgment.
